# static sanity: no imports outside stdlib, no file writes, no threads/processes
import ast
src = open('main.py').read()
tree = ast.parse(src)
imports = set()
for node in ast.walk(tree):
    if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
        imports.update(a.name for a in node.names)
    elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
        imports.add(node.module)
print("imports:", sorted(imports))
banned = ["threading", "multiprocessing", "subprocess", "socket", "os.fork", "asyncio", "numpy"]
for b in banned:
    if b in imports or (b+"(") in src.replace("os.fork",""):
        print("WARNING banned:", b)
print("open() calls:", src.count("open("))
print("write calls:", [l.strip() for l in src.splitlines() if ".write(" in l])
EOF
